scope: label-free feature contract only; no model training or performance claim

inputs.candidate_pool: fixed K17 plus three CEM rounds, 65 candidates per state
inputs.reference: formal frozen v70 archive selection for the same state

required_components: H1-H4 action sequence and candidate-minus-formal-v70 delta
H1-H4 LTWM latent summary and candidate-minus-formal-v70 delta
three-seed ATE/RTP/support values and candidate-minus-formal-v70 delta
proposal source round and within-round candidate index
formal-v70 candidate mapping and candidate hashes

raw_ltwm_contract.forbidden_claim: order statistics are not a consistent seed trajectory

fail_closed: sidecar manifest or file hash mismatch
formal archive source cannot be mapped uniquely
labels opened or reserve access reported
